claim: From 1 October 2022, UK occupational scheme trustees must carry out a qualifying tender, inviting bids from at least three unconnected providers, before a fiduciary management appointment that takes fiduciary-managed assets to 20% or more of manageable assets.
passage: threshold "is met where 20% or more of the manageable assets are managed by one or more FMPs"; "inviting (and using reasonable endeavours to obtain) bids from at least three unconnected FMPs"
notes: Certain scheme types are exempt; exemptions not reviewed here. Applies to trustees, not to how any manager organises its sales team.

claim: UK occupational scheme trustees are required to set objectives for providers of investment consultancy services.
passage: trustees "will be required to set objectives for persons who provide them with investment consultancy services"

claim: The FCA Consumer Principle is 'A firm must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers'; rules took effect 31 July 2023 for open products and 31 July 2024 for closed products.

notes: Framed around retail customers; does not establish how it applies to purely institutional mandates.
